title: Pilot autonomy contracts
description: The frozen shapes of the autonomy layer (C11): a scheduled task, the persisted task store, and a fire record. `when`/`next_due` are ISO 8601 timestamps resolved against the injected clock. A legacy reminders.json is migrated on read; a reminder is a one-shot task.

when.description: The first due time, as set (ISO 8601 or +<n><m|h|d>).

next_due.description: Resolved next fire instant (ISO 8601); absent once a one-shot is done or cancelled.

repeat.description: Recurrence: +<n><m|h|d>, daily@HH:MM, or weekly@<mon..sun>@HH:MM. Absent for a one-shot.

channel.description: Delivery target: `notify`, `origin` (the channel the task was created from), or a registered channel id. Defaults to the origin channel.

origin.description: Transport and sender that created the task, so it reports back where it came from.

last_run.description: The instant of the most recent fire (ISO 8601).

fireRecord.description: One fire (C11); written before the run starts, keyed by (task, due), so firing is idempotent.
